sourceReview: Direct source review, focused tests, full repository gates, and a two-launch built Electron journey.

findings.issue: Task Ledger normalizes workspace IDs into a storage key, while the binding payload uses the canonical Workspace registry ID.
findings.evidence: Binding validation compares the Task Ledger snapshot against normalizeTaskLedgerWorkspaceId(workspaceId); E2E bind succeeds under the real owner.

findings.issue: A coordinator handoff creates its SessionKey before a physical generation exists.
findings.evidence: The child starts as active/session-pending, and Chat send or resolve materializes the first real session generation without inventing one.

findings.issue: Chat could otherwise keep using the Workspace root after selecting a managed-worktree environment.
findings.evidence: Main chat-api resolves the persisted binding, validates state, generation and path, and forwards the bound root plus fingerprint.

findings.issue: Sequential revision checks did not prevent two concurrent revision-zero binds from both reading an empty map.
findings.evidence: Coordinator mutations are serialized; a concurrent bind test proves exactly one wins.

findings.issue: Isolated E2E delete could not run after a lazily materialized handoff because the fixture had no sessions.json.
findings.evidence: Live delete was not claimed in E2E; delete invalidation is covered by the direct lifecycle-owner unit test.

findings.issue: No external local-model review verdict was produced.
findings.evidence: No external review pass is claimed.

verdict: no-known-blocking-defect; live-delete E2E and external review unmeasured
limits: No live-provider model turn was executed; Chat environment enforcement and generation materialization are owner-boundary tests.
The managed-worktree path and branch-uniqueness checks use the existing Git owner contract in unit tests; the real Electron journey uses a canonical local checkout.
Delete invalidation is agent-tested at the lifecycle owner; the isolated E2E fixture could not produce sessions.json for a live delete.
